articles.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
articles.description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

articles.title: Embattled Spanish PM insists there were no prior warnings before Ceuta crisis
articles.description: Pedro Sánchez tells parliament it is absurd to think the government knew and did nothing, after thousands join protests in Spanish cities.

articles.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
articles.description: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.
